Class AnalyticsService

java.lang.Object
at.qe.skeleton.services.AnalyticsService
@Service public class AnalyticsService extends Object
Service responsible for all analytics and data-aggregation operations.

Role-based access matrix:

  • EMPLOYEE – own office (privacy-mode permitting) + common areas of their department.
  • DEPARTMENT_LEAD – all rooms in their department; office trends at reduced granularity when the room is above minimum occupancy; common areas at full granularity.
  • MANAGEMENT – aggregated department/company data only; violation breakdowns are anonymized (no room-level traceability).
  • BUILDING_ADMIN – full access to all measurement data; never sees user-room assignments.
  • SYSTEM_ADMIN – explicitly excluded from every endpoint (no access to climate data).

  • Method Details

    • getRoomSummary

      @PreAuthorize("hasAnyAuthority('EMPLOYEE','DEPARTMENT_LEAD','BUILDING_ADMIN')") public RoomSummaryDTO getRoomSummary(Long roomId, LocalDateTime from, LocalDateTime to)
      Returns a statistical summary (latest, avg, min, max, count) for every metric measured in the requested room over the given time window.

      Access rules:

      • EMPLOYEE – own office only (privacy-mode / minimum-occupancy guard applies); common areas of their department are always accessible.
      • DEPARTMENT_LEAD – any room that belongs to their department.
      • BUILDING_ADMIN – any room, unrestricted.

      When from / to are omitted the service defaults to the last 24 hours.

      Parameters:
      roomId - the ID of the room whose summary is requested
      from - optional window start (inclusive); defaults to to – 24 h
      to - optional window end (inclusive); defaults to now
      Returns:
      RoomSummaryDTO containing per-metric statistics
      Throws:
      org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException - if the caller lacks read access to the room
      ConflictException - if from is after to

    • getRoomTrend

      @PreAuthorize("hasAnyAuthority('EMPLOYEE','DEPARTMENT_LEAD','BUILDING_ADMIN')") public RoomTrendDTO getRoomTrend(Long roomId, Metric metric, LocalDateTime from, LocalDateTime to)
      Returns a time-series trend for a single metric in the requested room.

      Granularity rules:

      • EMPLOYEE / BUILDING_ADMIN – automatic bucket selection based on window length (raw ≤ 7 d, 1 h ≤ 90 d, 6 h ≤ 1 y, 1 d otherwise).
      • DEPARTMENT_LEAD viewing an office room above minimum occupancy – forced reduced granularity (minimum daily averages) regardless of window length, as required by the privacy specification.
      • DEPARTMENT_LEAD viewing a common area – full automatic granularity.

      When from / to are omitted the service defaults to the last 24 hours.

      Parameters:
      roomId - the ID of the room
      metric - the climate metric to retrieve (e.g., TEMPERATURE, CO2)
      from - optional window start; defaults to to – 24 h
      to - optional window end; defaults to now
      Returns:
      RoomTrendDTO containing the resolved bucket size and data points
      Throws:
      org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException - if the caller lacks read access to the room
      ConflictException - if from is after to

    • getDepartmentSummary

      @PreAuthorize("hasAnyAuthority('DEPARTMENT_LEAD','MANAGEMENT','BUILDING_ADMIN')") public DepartmentAnalyticsDTO getDepartmentSummary(Long departmentId, LocalDateTime from, LocalDateTime to)
      Returns an aggregated summary for an entire department: active violation count and average metric values across all active rooms in the requested time window.

      Access rules:

      • DEPARTMENT_LEAD – their own department only.
      • MANAGEMENT / BUILDING_ADMIN – any department.
      Parameters:
      departmentId - the ID of the department
      from - optional window start; defaults to to – 24 h
      to - optional window end; defaults to now
      Returns:
      DepartmentAnalyticsDTO with room count, active violations, windowed avg metrics, and current (latest-per-room) metric snapshot
      Throws:
      org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException - if a DEPARTMENT_LEAD requests another department

    • getDepartmentTrend

      @PreAuthorize("hasAnyAuthority('DEPARTMENT_LEAD','MANAGEMENT','BUILDING_ADMIN')") public DepartmentTrendDTO getDepartmentTrend(Long departmentId, Metric metric, LocalDateTime from, LocalDateTime to)
      Returns an aggregated time-series trend for a single metric across all active rooms in a department.

      Intended for trend-indicator views (improvement / deterioration over weeks / months). Bucket size is selected automatically based on the requested window.

      Access rules:

      • DEPARTMENT_LEAD – their own department only.
      • MANAGEMENT / BUILDING_ADMIN – any department.

      Default window when omitted: last 7 days.

      Parameters:
      departmentId - the ID of the department
      metric - the climate metric to aggregate
      from - optional window start; defaults to to – 7 d
      to - optional window end; defaults to now
      Returns:
      DepartmentTrendDTO with bucket size and aggregated data points
      Throws:
      org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException - if a DEPARTMENT_LEAD requests another department
      ConflictException - if from is after to

    • getDepartmentViolationSummary

      @PreAuthorize("hasAnyAuthority('DEPARTMENT_LEAD','MANAGEMENT','BUILDING_ADMIN')") public ViolationSummaryDTO getDepartmentViolationSummary(Long departmentId)
      Returns a violation summary for a department broken down by metric and (conditionally) by room.

      Anonymization rules:

      • MANAGEMENT – room-level breakdown is omitted; violations are not traceable to individual rooms, satisfying the anonymization requirement.
      • DEPARTMENT_LEAD / BUILDING_ADMIN – full room-level breakdown included.

      Access rules:

      • DEPARTMENT_LEAD – their own department only.
      • MANAGEMENT / BUILDING_ADMIN – any department.
      Parameters:
      departmentId - the ID of the department
      Returns:
      ViolationSummaryDTO with total, active, resolved counts and breakdowns
      Throws:
      org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException - if a DEPARTMENT_LEAD requests another department

      Returns a company-wide violation summary broken down by metric and (conditionally) by room.
